title: Microsoft’s AI future has fewer jobs
script:
Microsoft just offered sixty thousand workers voluntary buyouts.
The massive buyout offer covers over twenty-five percent of its entire staff.
CEO Satya Nadella has signaled AI will fundamentally shrink the company's workforce.
Eligible corporate employees across the US, UK, and Canada received packages.
This voluntary buyout plan gives thousands of workers a severance package today.
It is the clearest sign yet that AI automation is redefining tech roles.
Would you take a buyout if AI targeted your job?
